Method of Attack: Ransomware-as-a-service (RaaS) operation; Ransomware attacks disrupting operations of critical infrastructure and enterprises; Illegal circulation of means of payment (counterfeit credit cards and other payment documents, cryptocurrency)
Discoverer: Federal Security Service (FSB) of the Russian Federation
Attack Vector: Use of stolen credit cards and payment documents (carding)
Indicators of Compromise: Raids at homes of 14 suspected members
Seizure of more than $6.6 million in fiat and cryptocurrency
Arrests of eight individuals identified by Moscow’s Tverskoi Court
